title: Kerala
tagline: Tea hills, backwaters and slow golden beaches
description: Kerala rarely feels rushed. Winding roads climb through spice plantations to Munnar, where tea gardens roll across the hills and mist settles in the valleys each evening. Below, the backwaters of Alleppey drift past villages, paddy fields and coconut groves — best seen from the deck of a houseboat.

Add the wildlife of Periyar, the colonial streets and Chinese fishing nets of Fort Kochi, the thundering Athirappilly falls and the lighthouse beaches of Kovalam, and you have one of India's most rewarding and relaxing holidays.

highlights.title: Munnar's tea country
highlights.text: Tea estates, Eravikulam National Park, Mattupetty Dam and the Tea Museum in the cool Western Ghats.

highlights.title: Alleppey backwaters
highlights.text: Glide through palm-fringed canals and lagoons on a houseboat or shikara in the 'Venice of the East'.

highlights.title: Kovalam & Cherai beaches
highlights.text: Golden crescents of sand, lighthouse views, seafood shacks and sunsets over the Arabian Sea.

highlights.title: Kathakali & spice gardens
highlights.text: Watch a Kathakali performance in Thekkady and walk through plantations of cardamom, pepper and cinnamon.
